answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 8711 Country: India Title: Are hadiths related to tieing the hands on naaf in bukhari shareef and other eminent books zaeef, my friend is asking me and the version of bukhari which he is showing is published by madina university plz reply me with the necessary prove so that i can save myself and my freind from the fitnah of ahle-hadees Question: Are hadiths related to tieing the hands on naaf in bukhari shareef and other eminent books zaeef, my friend is asking me and the version of bukhari which he is showing is published by madina university plz reply me with the necessary prove so that i can save myself and my freind from the fitnah of ahle-hadees Answer ID: 8711 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2223/1717=H/1429) Holding hand below naaf (navel) in salah is proved form authentic traditions: ان علیا قال: السنۃ وضع الکف علی الکف فی الصلاۃ تحت السرۃ ( رواہ ابو داود فی نسخۃ ابن الاعرابی، والحدیث حسن) وعن ابی ھریرۃ قال: اخذ الکف علی الکف فی الصلاۃ تحت السرۃ (اعلاء السنن 2:166-167 ) For details see: اعلاء السنن 2:168 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
